'''Daltrid''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[S'kytri]] who served as [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] of the [[Lowlands (Skye)|Lowlands]] of [[Skye/Legends|Skye]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
